This regulation, via law, rules or procedures, can have various goals, for example intervention to protect a stated "public interest", or encouraging competition and an effective media market, or establishing common technical standards.

It uses a cylinder with multiple chambers, like those of a revolver handgun, to speed up the loading-firing-ejection cycle.  Some examples are also power-driven, to further speed the loading process.  Unlike a rotary cannon, a revolver cannon has only a single barrel, thus its spun weight is lower, lending itself to gas operation.  Automatic revolver cannon have been produced by many different manufacturers.
